name: Anakin
description:
Anakin gives Claude live access to the web. Scrape any URL and get clean markdown or AI-structured JSON, run AI-powered web search, map and crawl entire sites, or kick off multi-source deep research spanning several pages at once.

For the 940+ sites in Anakin's Wire catalog, pull structured data directly — product listings, prices, reviews — without writing a custom scraper. Wire can also run write actions on your own accounts, like submitting a form or updating a listing.

Set up scheduled monitors that watch a page, a whole site, or a Wire action, and get alerted by webhook or email when something changes — useful for tracking price drops, stock status, or content updates.

You can also compare how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overview answer the same question side by side, or run multi-step browser automation tasks in a cloud browser for sites that don't have a structured endpoint.

Authentication is OAuth-based — no API key to paste. Anakin mints a dedicated, revocable key scoped to your account. The free tier includes 300 credits with no card required; usage beyond that is credit-based. The connector never executes payments or transfers funds.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Anakin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Anakin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.anakin.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Anakin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anakin lists 21 MCP tools, including agentic_search, ai_visibility_search, ai_visibility_sources, browser_task, crawl, map, monitor_changes, monitor_control, monitor_create, monitor_list, scrape, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Anakin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Anakin in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Anakin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Anakin is developed by Anakin Technologies Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
